   - Understand the growth stages of potatoes and rutabagas and provide appropriate nutrients at each stage.

   - Use Fermented Fruit Juice (FFJ) as a pest attractant, placing it away from your crops to divert pests.
   - Implement companion planting in your alley cropping system to naturally repel pests.

4. Micropropagation:
   - Use this technique to produce disease-free potato and rutabaga seedlings, ensuring a healthy start for your crops.

5. Adapted Variable Rate Technology:
   - Instead of conventional precision agriculture, use manual observation and natural inputs to address specific areas of your field that need attention.
   - Apply IMOs, FPJ, and FFJ at variable rates based on crop needs and pest pressure in different areas.
